scenes.title: Intro
scenes.narration: Welcome to AI Portfolio Recommendation: a private, browser-based workspace for building and reviewing equity portfolios on Indian markets. In this walkthrough, we will sign in as an Admin and set up a project from scratch.

scenes.title: Local-first
scenes.narration: First, notice the Local Mode note. The app runs entirely in your browser. Price data, projects and settings are stored on your device, and nothing is sent to a server.

scenes.title: Sign in as Admin
scenes.narration: To sign in, enter a name, then choose a role. The Admin role has full access: creating projects, loading data and running analysis. Then click Continue.

scenes.title: Empty dashboard
scenes.narration: With no project yet, the dashboard offers two ways to start: create a new project, or import an existing project bundle. We will create a new one.

scenes.title: Name the project
scenes.narration: Project setup is a guided, four-step wizard. Step one: give the project a name.

scenes.title: Load data
scenes.narration: Normally, step two is where you upload three CSV files: daily price data, a sector mapping, and your benchmark index. Each file is checked right in the browser, with row counts, errors and warnings. For this demo, we will load the built-in sample of ten large-cap Indian stocks.

scenes.title: Benchmark
scenes.narration: Step three sets the benchmark used to measure alpha. NIFTY 50 is filled in by default, so we can move on.

scenes.title: Review and create
scenes.narration: Step four is a final review: project name, benchmark, the number of price records, and the stocks covered. Everything looks right, so let us create the project.

scenes.title: Portfolio dashboard
scenes.narration: And we land on the portfolio dashboard. The top row shows the headline numbers at a glance: compound annual growth, maximum drawdown, the Sortino ratio for risk-adjusted return, and the number of active signals, split into buy, hold and sell.

scenes.title: Charts and quick actions
scenes.narration: Below that are the equity curve and sector exposure panels, which fill in once analysis runs. As an Admin, you also get quick actions to run a backtest, build a what-if scenario, or generate a report.

scenes.title: Navigation and theme
scenes.narration: The sidebar is your map to every module: signals, portfolio, risk, backtesting, simulation and reports. It collapses to give charts more room, and light or dark themes are one click away.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.narration: That is the Admin workflow: from sign-in to a live project in about a minute, with all of your data staying on your own device.
